import h5py, numpy as np, scipy.sparse as sp
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

def load(f):
    with h5py.File(f,'r') as h:
        X=sp.csr_matrix((h['X/data'][:], h['X/indices'][:], h['X/indptr'][:]), shape=(len(h['obs/_index']), len(h['var/_index'])))
        guides=h['obs/guide/categories'][:].astype(str)
        codes=h['obs/guide/codes'][:]
        if 'obs/target_gene/categories' in h:
            targets=h['obs/target_gene/categories'][:].astype(str)
            tcodes=h['obs/target_gene/codes'][:]
        else:
            targets=None; tcodes=None
    return X, guides, codes, targets, tcodes

Xr, gr, cr, tr, tcr = load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
Xq, gq, cq, tq, tcq = load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')

def norm_log(X):
    sums=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel()
    sums[sums==0]=1
    return np.log1p(X.multiply(1/sums[:,None]*1e6).tocsr())

Lr=norm_log(Xr).toarray()
Lq=norm_log(Xq).toarray()
# means by guide
ur=[]
for i,g in enumerate(gr):
    m=Lr[cr==i].mean(0); ur.append(m)
ur=np.array(ur)
uq=[]
for i,g in enumerate(gq):
    m=Lq[cq==i].mean(0); uq.append(m)
uq=np.array(uq)
# ref NT means and query NT means
ntr=np.where(np.char.startswith(gr,'NT-'))[0]; ntq=np.where(np.char.startswith(gq,'NT-'))[0]
ref_ctrl=ur[ntr].mean(0); q_ctrl=uq[ntq].mean(0)
# top variable genes based on ref control+pert expression maybe
gene_mean=ur.mean(0); gene_var=ur.var(0)
# choose genes with mean > 0.01? Actually log normalized; use var top 2000
ngenes=2000
top=np.argsort(gene_var)[::-1][:ngenes]
# effect signatures centered
Er=ur-ref_ctrl; Eq=uq-q_ctrl
# normalize per gene? correlation
for name, Ea, ga, ctrl, targets_list, tc in [
    ('ref',Er,gr,ref_ctrl,tr,tcr),
    ('query',Eq,gq,q_ctrl,tq,tcq)]:
    pass
# only perturb guides
pr=[i for i,g in enumerate(gr) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
pq=[i for i,g in enumerate(gq) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
print('perturb ref',len(pr),'perturb query',len(pq))
# correlation of effect across top genes between each query guide and ref perturb target
C=np.zeros((len(pq),len(pr)))
Cabs=np.zeros_like(C)
for ii,q in enumerate(pq):
    for jj,r in enumerate(pr):
        x=Eq[q,top]; y=Er[r,top]
        C[ii,jj]=pearsonr(x,y)[0]
# best ref for each query
best=C.argmax(1)
for ii,q in enumerate(pq):
    j=best[ii]
    print('query',gq[q], 'best_ref',gr[pr[j]], 'target',tr[tcr==pr[j]][0] if tr is not None else '?', 'corr',C[ii,j].round(3), 'top2', C[ii].argsort()[-3:][::-1])
# also for desired targets, top query per target
print('\\nDesired targets query ranking:')
for target in ['PABPC1','NUDT21','LEO1']:
    # ref index(s)
    rinds=[pr[j] for j in range(len(pr)) if tr[tcr==pr[j]][0]==target]
    print(target, rinds)
    for ri in rinds:
        scores=C[:,rinds.index(ri) if False else np.where(np.array(pr)==ri)[0][0]]
        # recompute scores all query for this ri
        scores=np.array([pearsonr(Eq[q,top],Er[ri,top])[0] for q in pq])
        order=np.argsort(scores)[::-1][:10]
        for k in order:
            print(' ',gq[pq[k]], scores[k].round(3), gr[pr[k] if False else ri])

import h5py,numpy as np,scipy.sparse as sp

 with h5py.File(f,'r') as h:

  guides=np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in h['obs/guide/categories'][:]])

  genes=np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in h['var/_index'][:]])
  targets=np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in h['obs/target_gene/categories'][:]]) if 'obs/target_gene/categories' in h else None
  tcodes=h['obs/target_gene/codes'][:] if targets is not None else None
 return X,guides,codes,genes,targets,tcodes
Xr,gr,cr,gr_genes,tr,tcr=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad');Xq,gq,cq,gq_genes,tq,tcq=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
common,ri,qi=np.intersect1d(gr_genes,gq_genes,return_indices=True)
def norm(X):
 s=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel().astype(float);s[s==0]=1
 return np.log1p(X.multiply(1/s[:,None]*1e6).tocsr()).toarray()
Lr=norm(Xr[:,ri]);Lq=norm(Xq[:,qi]);ur=np.array([Lr[cr==i].mean(0) for i in range(len(gr))]);uq=np.array([Lq[cq==i].mean(0) for i in range(len(gq))])
ntr=[i for i,g in enumerate(gr) if g.startswith('NT-')];ntq=[i for i,g in enumerate(gq) if g.startswith('NT-')];Er=ur-ur[ntr].mean(0);Eq=uq-uq[ntq].mean(0)
guide2target={}
for i,g in enumerate(gr):
 if g.startswith('NT-'): continue
 vals,counts=np.unique(tr[tcr[cr==i]],return_counts=True);guide2target[g]=vals[np.argmax(counts)]
pr=[i for i,g in enumerate(gr) if not g.startswith('NT-')];pq=[i for i,g in enumerate(gq) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
top=np.argsort((ur.mean(0)+uq.mean(0))/2)[::-1][:1000]
A=Eq[pq][:,top];B=Er[pr][:,top]
Ac=A-A.mean(1,keepdims=True);Bc=B-B.mean(1,keepdims=True);den=np.sqrt((Ac*Ac).sum(1,keepdims=True))@np.sqrt((Bc*Bc).sum(1,keepdims=True)).T+1e-12;pear=Ac@Bc.T/den
Ar=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,1,A);Br=np.apply_along_axis(rankdata,1,B);Ac=Ar-Ar.mean(1,keepdims=True);Bc=Br-Br.mean(1,keepdims=True);den=np.sqrt((Ac*Ac).sum(1,keepdims=True))@np.sqrt((Bc*Bc).sum(1,keepdims=True)).T+1e-12;spear=Ac@Bc.T/den
for qname in ['guide2','guide14','guide1','guide11','guide6','guide13','guide18']:
 qi_=pq.index(gq.tolist().index(qname))
 print('\\n',qname,'n',(cq==gq.tolist().index(qname)).sum())
 for metric,C in [('pear',pear),('spear',spear)]:
  order=np.argsort(C[qi_])[::-1]
  print(metric,[(gr[pr[j]],guide2target[gr[pr[j]]],round(C[qi_,j],3)) for j in order[:8]])
